transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?
What finally scared me enough to come in is that I keep thinking it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t tried to hurt myself, but those thoughts keep coming up.
Aside from those thoughts, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or empty?
Yes. Most mornings I wake up with this heavy sadness in my chest, like I’ve already failed the day before the day even starts.
About how long have you been feeling this heavy sadness?
About four months now. It started around when my aunt came to live with us.
Before these past four months, have you ever experienced a period where you felt this down or depressed?
I’m not sure. I can’t really think of another time that felt like this.
Have you ever experienced a period of several days where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or felt like you barely needed any sleep?
No, I don’t think so. I can’t remember having a stretch like that where I felt unusually energetic or needed hardly any sleep.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?
Yes. I used to look forward to my watercolors, dance class, and walks with the ladies, but lately I just leave everything sitting there. I can’t seem to make myself care about doing any of it.
How has your sleep been over these past few months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to my sleep, I guess.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or lacking energy nearly every day?
Yes. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I still feel worn out. Simple things like making breakfast or carrying laundry take more out of me than they should.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight over these past few months?
I’m not sure, honestly. I haven’t really noticed any big change in my appetite or my weight.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating or focusing on things recently, like when reading or watching TV?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really paid attention to whether I’m having trouble focusing.
Have you been experiencing strong feelings of worthlessness or feeling like you are to blame for things?
Yes. When I’m tired or get annoyed with my aunt, I start thinking I’m a bad woman. Like I should be more grateful, and I’m bringing shame on my family by not being.
